### 2026-10-11 – 10/11/26: Work on the given guide for the code with couple adjustments customized

**0.8h**

10/11/26: Work on the given guide for the code with couple adjustments customized

So worked on the code. Went through the guide and followed along.
So here is a overview of what I did:

1. So started off by going through my model and made sure that the pcb pins line up with the ones in the code, no changes needed to be made there. Also kept the DHT sensor to true

2. I rewrote the radial menu labels to be space themed, added Dock, Warp, fuel, and Spark. Kept the stat changes the same though

3. Added my custom sprtie. As I wrote in the code, wanted to do my dog but wouldn't look good. Instead had my AI agent make an image of itself and put that into the website the guide gave us and used that. Bascially looks like a robot which makes sense...

4. Added the drawSparkle function and that special effect that I was supposed to.

Heres some pics. Gonna now after this maybe customize PCB a bit and confirm rest is all good. Also will make some more changes in code

### 2026-10-11 – **10/11/26: Finishing up code customization**

**1h**

**10/11/26: Finishing up code customization**

So now I finished customizing my code. Here's what I did:

Change the drawSparkle function to make a 4 pointed star that has like a little trail to it to fit the space theme

Also changed the speed of Starbie (changed from 70 to 45 to make starbie slower) and how high it jumps (changed from 16 to 24 to make much bigger jump)

Also added custom sleep graphic to make cooler

Added stars that randomly go across screen in background to keep space like vibe going, shooting stars kinda

Got the thing made and now having some trouble with data types etc, working through it though

Had to change the drawCurrentView function to make it work in loop as that is called there
